mapper.select: SELECT id, email, password_hash, google_id, display_name, is_guest, email_verified, created_at, last_login_at FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, email, password_hash, google_id, display_name, is_guest, email_verified, created_at, last_login_at FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (id, email, password_hash, google_id, display_name, is_guest, email_verified, created_at, last_login_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{googleId}, #{displayName}, #{guest}, #{emailVerified}, #{createdAt}, #{lastLoginAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, is_guest = #{guest}, email_verified = #{emailVerified}, last_login_at = #{lastLoginAt} WHERE id = #{id}
